REHEARSED ON-CHAIN 2026-09-18. THE REAL POOL IS binStep 10 at 0x864d4e5Ee7318e97483DB7EB0912E09F161516EA (TVL ~$710,611; 27,486 WAVAX + 491,745 USDC). THERE ARE FOUR WAVAX/USDC PAIRS IN THE V2.2 FACTORY AND THREE ARE DECOYS with no liquidity (binStep 100 ~$132 quoting $10.15; binStep 25 ~$6 quoting $29.12; binStep 50 $0 quoting $34.85) against a REAL market of $7.96 — they answer every call normally and quote a confident wrong price 27-337% off market, AND they carry 5-15x higher fees. SELECT BY HIGHEST LIQUIDITY, never first result (same rule as the remnant-NFT bug). TOKEN ORDER VERIFIED: tokenX=WAVAX, tokenY=USDC, so price is USDC-per-WAVAX and a single-sided USDC position must sit BELOW the active bin (deltaIds negative, distributionX=[0]) where it acts as a BID. FEE LAW READ FROM CHAIN: baseFactor=5000, variableFeeControl=40000, maxVolatilityAccumulator=350000, protocolShare=1000 — base take 0.0500%, surge term 0.0018% at volatilityAccumulator 21257, TOTAL TAKE NOW 0.0518%, and 0.5400% at max volatility = a 10.4x SURGE. This INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMS the 0.054% implied take backed out of DefiLlama. LIKELY ERROR IN THE HEADLINE: protocolShare=1000 means the protocol takes 10% BEFORE LPs are paid, so the LP-effective take is 0.0466% giving ~77.9% APR at current volume — DefiLlama's 90.7% is consistent with the GROSS take and does not appear to deduct the protocol share. Stated as a hypothesis, not asserted. ORDERING STILL HOLDS: ~78-90% beats Black Hole's measured 47% and is still pure fee income, zero emissions.

CANDIDATE-SET GAP found by the 2026-09-26 fee-rank run: this venue is NOT in pool-fee-rank.py's CANDIDATES dict, so it NEVER appears in the ranking despite being the highest fee-generating AVAX pair per TVL that run could see. Aggregator-reported apyBase 283.0% on $141,369 TVL with $2,192,241 daily volume = 15.5x turnover; implied take 283/(15.5x365) = 0.050%, exactly the standard 0.05% tier, which is why the number is arithmetically self-consistent rather than a spike artifact. TREAT THE LEVEL AS VOLATILE, NOT DURABLE: the pool's own 30d apyBase history runs median 8.6% and printed 9293.8% on a day when TVL was $78K (same volume, 1/5 the TVL). TVL grew $78K -> $141K over 30d, so the ratio is moving with deposits as well as volume. CHAIN READ PENDING - this is aggregator arithmetic only, no measurement of ours, so per standing rule it may NOT be ranked as a yield and must not be quoted as one. Note the pair is NATIVE AVAX-USDC (token0 = 0x0), not WAVAX-USDC, so a deposit is a different asset path from our LFJ book. Action needed before this can rank: (1) an on-chain read of the real V4 pool (TVL + fee tier + hook surface), (2) a decision on whether to enrol 'uniswap-v4' in CANDIDATES - that changes the ranked universe and the headline, so it is Jordan's call, not a silent edit.
